title: 'When you play me, ready another friendly Mech' readies nothing even with exhausted friendly Mechs present
expected: Bubble Bot's parsed ability is ready{target:{type:unit,controller:friendly,filter:{tag:"Mech"},excludeSelf:true}} (verified at runtime via getAllCards()). target-resolver.ts:463-465 matches filter.tag strictly against registry def.tags (`return tags?.includes(filter.tag) ?? false`). No card in getAllCards() carries tags containing "Mech" (runtime check: zero matches) — bubble-bot.ts:4-15, mega-mech.ts, breakneck-mech.ts have no `tags`; sfd.json:2348 has "tags": []; sandbox Mech token registration (game-definition/moves/token.ts:133-161) and ability-minted tokens (abilities/effects/create-token.ts:92-98,139-145) register name/might/keywords but no tags. So the filter can never match, targets is empty, and handle_ready (abilities/effects/ready.ts:13-14) fizzles because a target spec exists. Nothing is readied.
observed: Trigger went on chain as ready{target:{type:unit,controller:friendly,filter:{tag:'Mech'},excludeSelf:true}} with no targets/pendingChoice; after passChainPriority all friendly units (Mech token, Recruit token, first Bubble Bot) stayed exhausted:true. Tested twice: once with an exhausted Mech token, once (via duplicateCard) with an exhausted printed Bubble Bot as the other Mech. Root cause visible in data: target-resolver matches filter.tag against def.tags, but no card def (bubble-bot.ts, mega-mech.ts, etc.) nor the sandbox Mech token def carries tags:['Mech'], so the filter can never match.

history.note: verified fixed (Mech tags on card defs + token registration); added token/duplicate regressions
